ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Okilo listens for your commands during a session ("done", "8", "later") when you turn them on.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Okilo recognizes your commands on the phone, nothing is sent.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Okilo does not use your photo library: you will never be asked for this permission.
ios.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Okilo rings the end of your rest like a timer, even when you are in another app.
